channel.title: Variator Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1734)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1734)

Reliable TikTok and Reels export across Medium and Voice Separation pipelines, instant Use Original hook extraction with live canvas visibility, opaque circular Yope stickers at the playhead, native hard-cut collage timing, and calibrated Classic TikTok Outline thickness.

Fix Medium export replay validation, voice separation fallback, and session run-binding recovery.

Preserves source audio stream duration during Medium speed and pitch rendering, automatically retries voice separation on CPU with clean error reporting when hardware acceleration fails, and self-heals stale run bindings and working input provenance during session save and export.

Copy original on-screen hook text on demand, keep edited hooks visible on canvas, and set TikTok outline to 3.5.

Clicking Use Original in the Hook section now runs fast Vision text recognition on the opening frames whenever transcript hooks are empty, always populates the editor, keeps replaced hook text visible on the video preview canvas, and defaults Classic TikTok Outline thickness to 3.5 with zero-fade hard cuts on hooks and collages.

Add seven opaque circular Yope stickers and insert them directly at the timeline cursor.

Replaces automatic word-snapping with seven fully opaque circular Yope sticker variants from the marketing sheet and adds an Add Yope Logo at Playhead button that places the selected sticker right at the current timeline position.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1733)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1733)

FullAppCheck 1.0 4-stage combinatorial QA & Single-Mode ghost-parameter isolation, Scene Studio transitions across live preview, recipes & batch queue, and 10-bit HDR PNG decoding.

Wire Scene Studio transitions across live preview, recipes, and batch queue with 10-bit HDR frame decoding.

Connects per-cut Scene Studio transition effects across interactive preview, Smart Auto-Recipes, and batch queue rendering, while adding 10-bit HDR PNG decoding and protected-region vision detection so HDR source clips process without color or channel failures.

Zero dormant parameter leaks when feature toggles are off and lossless mode-switching across Canvas items.

Prevents disabled Color Grading, Crop, Look, Subtitle, and Hook Banner sub-settings from leaking into exported plans or manifests, preserves custom text and canonical bezel/top-center coordinates when switching through iPhone Volume HUD, and supports timing and rotation on stickers without schema errors.

Preserve original source lineage on unwrapped localization receipts and add FullAppCheck 1.0 nightly verification.

Records normalization.original provenance when unwrapping localized working videos, allows empty text or username on reply stickers during live editing, and introduces the 4-stage FullAppCheck 1.0 combinatorial verification suite.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1730)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1730)

Full-video Hook timeline stretch with static-text coalescing, face-overlap LaMa erase guard, zero unwanted auto-erase on Create Variant, scene-cut localization verification parity, and unified layer z-order reordering.

Stretch Hook text across the full video duration without snapping back to the 3.0s cut.

Dragging the orange Hook timeline bar past the 3.0s scene cut now smoothly extends across the entire video duration, promotes scope to full-video, persists custom duration, snaps magnetically only within 0.12s of a cut, and coalesces duplicate static 1-frame captions into one bar.

Zero unwanted LaMa text erasing on Create Variant and automatic face-overlap protection.

Restores the clean original video source whenever Erase was not explicitly requested, prevents Hook Replace or Hook Collage from triggering background LaMa erasing when Market is Off, and blocks default AI erasing when text sits directly over a person's face with an amber plate recommendation.

Scene-cut localization verification parity, bright-background outline preservation, and unified layer z-order.

Clamps Hook localization verification spans to the first scene cut so post-cut frames never trigger false OCR readback errors, preserves thin dark outlines on bright backgrounds, ignores zero-alpha crop padding during residue checks, and adds unified layer z-order controls across preview, context menu, and inspector.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1727)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1727)

7-game Variator Mini-Arcade with Space Blaster & Cyber Stack (easier physics and 2x level lengths), 18-pattern Force Touch Taptic Engine & Micro-Acoustic Haptics Lab, and per-pool Recipe Roll actions.

7-game Variator Mini-Arcade with Space Blaster, Cyber Stack, forgiving physics, and 2x level lengths.

Adds Space Blaster (dual auto-laser against 12 aliens) and Cyber Stack (magnetic 10-floor block tower) alongside Pixel Pong, Brick Breaker, Asteroid Dodge, Retro Snake (with wall wrap-around), and Jetpack Runner (150pt gate gap), tuned with forgiving hitboxes and doubled level targets during heavy renders.

18-pattern Force Touch Taptic Engine and Micro-Acoustic Haptics Demo Lab across timeline and canvas.

Delivers tactile and micro-acoustic feedback across timeline scrubbing, magnetic playhead/layer snaps, and pro controllers, with a live Haptics Demo Lab supporting per-event variant selection, pitch tuning (0.5x–1.8x), and pulse count (1x/2x/3x) customization.

Independent per-pool Recipe Roll actions, clarified Video to Batch action, and CANON-50 snapshot bounds.

Fixes independent per-pool Roll actions in Recipe pools, clarifies Video to Batch workflow controls, and enforces CANON-49/CANON-50 15%–300% maxWidthPercent clamping across persisted project snapshots.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1724)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1724)

Timeline precision click-to-position & 30fps playhead synchronization, 20.8x faster Temporal Lookaround Inpainting with crop/ring guards, unified Inspector ergonomics, and DumbGate 15-contract / 22 Real End-to-End Scenarios verification.

Timeline precision click-to-position and 30fps playhead synchronization across all tracks and pills.

Clicking anywhere on a timeline track or pill seeks directly to the exact clicked playhead position without jumping to 0.0s, while live playback drives timeline playhead progress smoothly at 30fps.

20.8x faster Temporal Lookaround Inpainting with edge-case crop & ring guards and single-pass clean plate fast path.

Temporal lookaround inpainting in heal_engines.py now runs 20.8x faster with strict <16px crop and boundary ring guards, paired with a single-pass clean plate fast path and bounded Swift hot-path caches with exact invalidation keys.

Deduplicated Erase Region controller, smart accordion routing, natural tab sizing, and 22 Real Scenarios.

Selecting a timeline layer automatically opens and routes to the matching inspector accordion group with a single deduplicated Erase Region controller, natural tab sizing in HookFineTuningBlock, an always-visible Font selector, and full DumbGate (CANON-50) 15-contract / 75-probe + 22 Real End-to-End Scenarios verification.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1723)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1723)

4-stage temporal lookaround inpainting & Semantic Batch Binding, unified Timeline Element Erase/Replace inspector (+ Erase) with 300% text wrap handles & + Media cutout, and post-update disk hygiene with split feedback/snapshot telemetry.

4-stage temporal lookaround inpainting engine and Semantic Batch Binding across formats and cuts.

Hook and caption erasing now borrows clean pixels across neighbor frames (±8f/12f/18f) using DIS optical flow with a 1.5px forward-backward consistency check, propagates keyframe inpaints, applies motion-compensated temporal median de-flickering, and restores sensor grain. Batch recipes automatically adapt hook/face placement, scene-cut duration clamping, and font safe zones across 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and 16:9 clips.

Unified Timeline Element Erase/Replace inspector (+ Erase), decoupled 300% text wrap handles, and + Media cutout.

Clicking any timeline pill or + Erase opens a minimal 1-tab inspector (Keep / Erase / Replace, Mode: LaMa AI / Letters / Box, Margin 0–24px, Feather 0–16px) with a draggable red erase box on the video preview. Corner handles scale text size while side handles control words-per-line up to 300% width, and + Media unifies timeline phase presets (Hook 0–3s, In Pause, Outro, All Video) with multi-tier background cutout.

Post-update Sparkle & localize scratch hygiene, 2-file log rotation, 15MB .git compaction, and separated feedback/ vs. snapshots/ channels.

First launch after an update purges stale Sparkle update caches and orphaned localize scratch folders (≥15 min old), splits runtime logs into 2 bounded files (512 KB cap) with a 2 MB in-memory stdout/stderr cap, compacts the diagnostics .git index when over 15 MB, and separates human user feedback from automated error snapshots (snapshots/) with inline screenshot previews in Black Box.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1713)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1713)

120fps player and timeline scrubbing, granular canvas bitmap caching, Esc-to-unfocus keyboard flow, and faster in-memory mask and OCR localization.

Zero-hitch 120fps scrubbing, granular bitmap cache, and steady playhead during edits.

Player refresh and timeline rendering now use cached presentation dimensions and clip durations instead of synchronous disk or track queries, editing Hook text or style sliders keeps the playhead steady and invalidates only the edited canvas item, and pressing Esc cleanly exits text fields so Space immediately toggles playback.

In-memory PNG mask encoding, doubled OCR batches, and self-healing background sync.

Caption and plate masks are now encoded directly in memory without spawning FFmpeg subprocesses, OCR batch size is doubled to cut Vision helper startup overhead in half, ASR model hashes and audio capabilities are cached in memory, and background sync automatically cleans up interrupted rebase locks.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1712)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1712)

Hero Hook text composer at the top of Hook settings, continuous stepped rounded pill plates with zero letter clipping, and faster preview and pipeline caching.

Hero Hook text input at the top of Hook settings and continuous stepped rounded plates.

The Hook text composer and font bar now sit right at the top of the Hook card with a high-contrast accent border, while multi-line rounded plates trace a continuous stepped polygon with smooth inner and outer corner arcs and guaranteed horizontal padding so letters are never clipped.

Instant position dragging, cached credential and glossary reads, and parallel patch checks.

Dragging horizontal and vertical position sliders no longer clears the text bitmap cache, voice credentials and speech glossaries are cached in memory, and inpainting patch verification runs in parallel batches with file hash caching.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1711)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1711)

Unified Active Parameter Text & Hook Controller (CANON-49), CANON-50 DumbGate 6-Pass Discovery & Zero-Throw Auto-Clamping, and once-per-day post-update What's New gate.

Active Parameter Text & Hook Controller with 500 Medium TikTok weight.

Editable text sits directly above 5 compact tabs ([Font] [Plate] [Outline] [Shadow] [Pos]), showing only the active parameter group for both Hook and Text on Video items while calibrated to native TikTok 500 Medium weight.

DumbGate (CANON-50 / G30) zero-throw auto-clamping and 6-Pass boundary parity.

Session encoding never throws CanvasModelError, continuous variable-font weights (100...900), tight line spacing (0.7...2.0), capsule plates, and 50...200% size scaling work seamlessly across Swift, VisionHelper, and TypeScript, and out-of-range values are automatically clamped on save and load.

What's New opens only after an app update, at most once per calendar day.

Both the What's New sheet and the Presentation deck open automatically only when the app build number changes (upgrade) and no post-update presentation has already been shown on the same calendar day.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1707)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1707)

Isolated preview canvas element dragging from window movement while preserving smooth native titlebar dragging across the top header strip.

Dragging text, hooks, and stickers on the video preview never moves the window.

Window background dragging is disabled on the SwiftUI content view so dragging text overlays, hook banners, stickers, or resize handles in the preview canvas moves only the selected element, while dragging the top header strip moves the window smoothly.

item.title: Version 0.4.0 (1705)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.0 (Build 1705)

Resilient batch queue asset recovery, concurrent inference lease waiting, opening hook caption deduplication, adaptive multi-line hook wrapping, and pre-decode project snapshot sanitization across 50 replayed production runs.

Automatic asset identity refresh and queued inference slot waiting.

Batch and TikTok imports automatically refresh updated working assets when the primary source file exists on disk, while concurrent local inference jobs wait cleanly for the active model slot instead of failing immediately.

Opening hook track deduplication and natural multi-line fallback layout.

Synthesizing a detected opening hook removes overlapping opening caption tracks so two translations never render on top of each other, and long translated hooks fall back to natural multi-line wrapping instead of failing.
